== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Muddy Terrain]].
* This skill cancels the natural Movement Speed bonus foes receive in [[Hard mode]].
* The "non-spirit" part of the description is usually unneeded since most spirits cannot move anyway (see talk page).

== Trivia ==
* This skill was [[Elite skill|elite]] during the Prophecies beta testing.
